## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (including the case that must be **refused**, if this touches approvals, files or permissions)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/`), and `docs/LIMITATIONS.md` if something is not covered
- [ ] No real names, emails, CVs, tokens or captured traffic in the diff
- [ ] I did not weaken the ground rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (human approval, untrusted page content, redaction, local-only, least privilege)
